originalTitle: Trump demands Iran pay compensation for decades of US soldier deaths
summary: US president’s statement is latest sign that negotations to end war and reopen strait of Hormuz have stalled
content: Donald Trump has said he will demand that Iran pay compensation for the deaths of thousands of US soldiers and Iran’s own civilians killed in recent decades in the latest sign his negotiations to end the war and reopen the strait of Hormuz have reached an impasse. The US president is trying to end conflicts in Iran, Gaza and Lebanon, and his additional demands of Iran are likely to provoke anger in Tehran at the same time as Israel has rejected Trump’s terms for a 15-point roadmap to end the war in Gaza. In a post on Truth Social, Trump said he was issuing the demand for war reparations in response to Iranian negotiators making similar claims for damages for the five-month war that has killed thousands and devastated Iran’s military and economy. “Now I am likewise demanding compensation from Iran, for all of the people that they have killed and gravely wounded with their roadside bombs and many conflicts, for which they are famous, as led initially by Gen Soleimani, including the families of those killed on the USS Cole, and thousands of others killed in combat,” he wrote on Truth Social. “Additionally, compensation should be paid to the families of the hundreds of thousands of innocent protesters that Iran has killed over the last 50 years, not to mention the 52,000 that have been killed in the last five months.” The demands are likely to be a nonstarter for Iran’s leaders in the careful peace negotiations aimed at reopening the strait of Hormuz, through which 20% of global oil trade flowed before the US and Israel launched joint strikes on Iran in late February. Trump and other senior negotiators have claimed many times that a deal is imminent, although none has materialised. The remarks followed a series of setbacks for Trump’s efforts to end several Middle East conflicts before the midterm elections in November, in which high oil prices and inflation will probably hurt fellow Republicans at the polls. On Sunday, the Israeli prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, said he rejected the Trump-backed Board of Peace’s 15-point plan to end Israel’s war in Gaza. Netanyahu had said Hamas must fully disarm before Israel would consider pulling out of Gaza, rather than the phased withdrawal proposed by the Board of Peace. Netanyahu framed the decision as a rejection of US pressure on Israel to make peace in several wars in the Middle East. “Unlike all those who lecture us, we do what needs to be done for Israel’s security, and we can and know how to stand our ground, even against our best friends when necessary,” Netanyahu said. Trump has not replied to Netanyahu’s statement, which was a remarkably public break between the leaders of the US and its closest ally in the Middle East. But in response to a shouted question in the Oval Office on Monday, he said his relationship with Netanyahu was “very good”. Trump has sought to increase pressure on Iran. An hour after his first post demanding war reparations from Tehran, he broadened their scope to include the victims of recent wars throughout the region. “Also, with respect to the Iran negotiations, Iran should be responsible for the damages and death caused to the people of Lebanon, Syria, Yemen, and Gaza!” he wrote.
chineseTitle: 特朗普要求伊朗赔偿数十年美国士兵死亡
chineseSummary: 美国总统的声明是结束战争和重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的谈判陷入僵局的最新迹象
chineseContent: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将要求伊朗为近几十年来被杀害的数千名美国士兵和伊朗本国平民支付赔偿金，这是他结束战争和重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的谈判陷入僵局的最新迹象。美国总统正试图结束伊朗、加沙和黎巴嫩的冲突，他对伊朗的额外要求可能会激起德黑兰的愤怒，同时以色列拒绝了特朗普关于结束加沙战争的 15 点路线图的条款。特朗普在《Truth Social》上发表的一篇文章中表示，他提出战争赔偿要求是为了回应伊朗谈判代表对这场持续五个月的战争提出的类似索赔要求，这场战争已造成数千人死亡，并摧毁了伊朗的军事和经济。他在《Truth Social》上写道：“现在我同样要求伊朗赔偿所有因路边炸弹和许多冲突而丧生和重伤的人，这些冲突是他们最初由苏莱马尼将军领导的，其中包括科尔号战舰上遇难者的家属，以及在战斗中丧生的数千人。” “此外，应该向伊朗在过去50年中杀害的数十万无辜抗议者的家人进行赔偿，更不用说在过去五个月里被杀害的52,000人了。”在旨在重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的谨慎和平谈判中，这些要求对于伊朗领导人来说可能是不可能的。在美国和以色列于 2 月底对伊朗发动联合打击之前，全球 20% 的石油贸易是通过霍尔木兹海峡进行的。特朗普和其他高级谈判代表多次声称即将达成协议，但最终没有达成。在此之前，特朗普结束几场中东会议的努力遭遇了一系列挫折。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
